The written g_j is measured at the current VLA/WAM parameters through a black-box simulator response, SVD-derived modes, rank selection, and a sign-stability partition; it is not a differentiable function of the tentative joint update. Literal autodiff therefore yields c_j = 0, making every constraint with g_j > 0 infeasible. Interpreting c_j as a derivative after hypothetically applying an update does not repair the procedure because no such re-evaluation graph or finite-difference estimator is supplied and the graph crosses non-differentiable simulator/discrete operations. The constraint additionally mixes expansion points by using current-parameter g_j with the displacement (u_tilde-u).

Those changes redesign the load-bearing mechanism and cannot be made by a coherence wording patch.
